book.name: 2 Akakolintu
book.title: Baluwa jhubhele jha Pauli kwa Akakolintu

content: Bhahe, anda tuhenga mahengo pamonga na Chapanga, tumpembelekeya nkotoka kujheketela umbone ghola ghumpokii uhobholele jhajhe.
Chapanga alongela naha mu Majhandiko ghake,
Ninnobholela, ngohe ndi lichaa lilipalitwa kwa umbone gwa Chapanga, deleno ndi lichiko lya ughombokeko!
Tupala jhe kummeke mundo jhojhoha kihibhilikiho, yenio lihengo lito likoto kubhehe kilebhe nacho.
Nambo tupalwa kulangiya kwa uchakaka kilebhe chituhenga kubhehe akatumiche bha Chapanga kwa kuhimbilila putubhehe mu malagho manonoho na mu malola ghoha.
Tubulitwe na tutabhitwe mu kipungo na tukabulitwe na bhando, tuhengite lihengo linonoho ade kutotokela, tugholwika jhe na kutama changalye.
Tukalangii kubhehe akatumiche bha Chapanga kwa kutama kwa unyahinyahi kwa kumanya kwa luhimba kwa umbone mu Uhuke gwa Chapanga na kwa upalo gwa chakaka,
na kwa lilobhe lya chakaka na kwa makakala gha Chapanga. Tuhenga ghighanhalalicha Chapanga ndi chilaa jhito jha kukomanila na jha kukikengelela.
Tuichimika na kupuchwa, kukokolekewa na kulumbililwa. Anda bhando bhibhahobhecha bhange, nambo tulongela chakaka,
tubhonekana ngita twangamanyikana, nambo tubhii kumanyikana kwa bhoha, tukabhonike anda tuhwile, nambo twamela ghome ade ngohe. Tubulitwe nambo bhatukoma ndeka.

Pamonga na bhubhabhii ngolongondi machiko ghoha tuhangana, twakahocho nambo twatenda bhando bhabha na ilebhe twe, tubhonekana twanga kilebhe, tubhonekana anda akahocho nambo tukwete ilebhe yamahele, anda bhabhii jhe na kilebhe, nambo tukwete kila ilebhe.
Makalongo bhito Akakolintu, tukannobholile hotuhotu na mangota, na miojho jhito ikadindwike kwino.
Twenga tunhibhilikii jhe kumpala, nambo mangota mukihibhilikiye kutupala twenga.
Ngohe nilonge na mangota ngita yana yango, mutupale twenga ngita twenga chitumpala.
Mwangalombana na bhando bhala bhangammanya Chapanga, bho, ghaumbone na mabhoho ghahotola kubhehe pamonga? Bho, lumule na lubhendo bhahoto kutama pamonga?
Bho, Kilichitu na Limbembela bhajhokanikihana? Bho, mundo jwannyeketile Kilichitu na jwangannyeketela bhajhokanikihana?
Bho, Nyumba jha Chapanga na inyagho ihoto kubhehe pamonga? Nhwalo twenga ndi Nyumba jha Chapanga jwabhii ghome. Anda Chapanga jwenio akalongii,

content.text: na mangota chamma yana yango inalome na ikeghe,
